description: Angular component for configuring chart fill settings, including fill type, opacity, and gradient options, with form validation and change propagation.

classes.name: ChartFillSettingsComponent
classes.description: Angular component for managing chart fill settings with form controls, validation, and change handling.

methods.name: ngOnInit
methods.description: Initializes form group, sets up value change subscriptions, and populates fill type translations.

methods.name: registerOnChange
methods.description: Registers a callback function to propagate changes to the form value.

methods.name: registerOnTouched
methods.description: Placeholder for registering touch callback (not implemented).

methods.name: setDisabledState
methods.description: Enables or disables the form controls based on the input boolean.

methods.name: writeValue
methods.description: Patches form controls with provided ChartFillSettings value and updates validators.

methods.name: updateValidators
methods.description: Adjusts form validators and control states based on selected fill type.

methods.name: updateModel
methods.description: Updates internal model and propagates change when form values change.
